synopsis: The tools chapter and glossary identify Fraunhofer ITWM as a research/service option with off-road and heavy-machinery relevance, covering construction-site digital twins, operator-in-the-loop simulation, real-data environments and soil simulation [f8665, f8823, f16113, f9172]. InVerS integrates sensor-data acquisition through operator alerting in simulation, while RODOS provides a human-in-the-loop simulator option [f8819, f8820, f16047]. VMC Road & Scene-Generator creates 3D scenes for camera, lidar and radar simulation from fused real data sources using the REDAR measurement vehicle [f8612]. Demify adds soil DEM capability, and the broader InVerS, RODOS and VMC research portfolio covers construction-site digital twins, commercial vehicles and excavator loads [f8822, f8694]. However, the supporting institute pages are classified as vendor evidence, and heavy-machine deployment detail for VMC was not found on the reviewed page; stated relevance should therefore not be treated as documented deployment evidence [f8694, f8613, f8823].
